title: Quick Context Menu (SettingsAndHelp)

scenarios.title: Quick Context Menu applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Quick Context Menu (BtnQuickContextMenu) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: Popup entry rule (order, unknown/duplicate filtering, cap) pinned host-free
scenarios.expected: The popup's entry rule: configured ids keep their order; unknown ids are dropped against the ordinal known-id set (a differently cased id counts as unknown); only the first duplicate survives; null or whitespace ids are skipped without eating into the cap; a null known-id set disables the unknown filter (historical behavior); the list caps at MaximumItems=12 keeping the first configured items; the six default ids are distinct, within the cap and survive normalization unchanged.

scenarios.title: Default popup ids still resolve as user-visible commands (popup crash guard)
scenarios.expected: Every Quick Context Menu default id (BtnAlignLeft, BtnAlignTop, BtnMatchWidth, BtnMatchHeight, BtnCopyXY, BtnPasteXY) still exists in the current catalog as a user-visible, non-obsolete command - a rename, hide or obsoletion of any of them would otherwise throw KeyNotFoundException when the popup builds its catalog dictionary.
